story.title: Open-weight AI is having its Kubernetes moment

draft:
I'm seeing parallels between open-weight AI and Kubernetes' rise to prominence. 
Open-weight AI is gaining traction, much like Kubernetes did, by solving a key problem: model size and complexity. 
Key benefits include increased efficiency and flexibility. 
What does this mean for the future of AI development?
